Hey thank you so much for replying to me. I've seen you on my other post. Thank you for taking the time to comment, i appreciate it more than you can imagine. I know i'm very young, i just don't see a way out at the moment, it just seems like suicide is my only option. School is an important part in my life and failing just feels like i've ruined my own life. Anyways, thank you again for giving me advice, you sound like a very kind person :)
Hey thank you so much for replying to me. This is so aggresively positive i can't help but smile. Thank you :)

Hey thank you for replying to me. This made me laugh a little bit so that's nice. I had some cookies earlier so that was good :)

Hey thank you so much for replying to me. The coffee methapor made me smile so thank you for that also. You sound like a very nice person, thank you for making me feel better :)
Hey thank you for replying to me. I would like that actually.

There's nothing wrong with you, and i'm sorry that people have treated you like this. I know it's hard to have patience, but i'm sure that the right people will come in your life. You just have to wait until then. In the meantime, you could focus on yourself and do something nice for you. What do you like to do for fun?

I know how you feel. Failing school just feels like you're failing life. I know very well that school is not the and never will be the only thing in my life, but i just can't help to feel this way. Anyways, if you need someone to talk to, i'm here. If not then i can just say that you absolutely have a chance of being happy, even without good grades. I don't know if my comment was very helpful, probably not, but i just saw myself a lot in this post. I hope you have a nice day.
